title: Dr. Post-Training: A Data Regularization Perspective on LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.07063v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data selection methods address a critical challenge in LLM post-training: effectively leveraging scarce, high-fidelity target data alongside abundant but imperfectly aligned general training data. In this work, we move beyond the data-selection framing and introduce Dr. Post-Training (Data-Regularized Post-Training), a novel framework that reconceptualizes general training data as a data-induced regularizer that prevents overfitting to the scarce target objective, rather than serving as a pool for selection. Specifically, our framework proposes that, at each training step, we construct a feasible set of model update directions using the general training data, and project the model update direction specified by the scarce target data onto that feasible set. translated_title: Dr. Post-Training：从数据正则化视角看大语言模型后训练
translated_abstract: 数据选择方法旨在解决大语言模型后训练中的一个关键挑战：如何有效利用稀缺的高保真目标数据与大量但不完全对齐的通用训练数据。在这项工作中，我们超越了数据选择的框架，提出了 Dr. Post-Training（数据正则化后训练），这是一个新颖的框架，它将通用训练数据重新概念化为一种由数据诱导的正则化器，用于防止模型对稀缺目标任务的过拟合，而不是将其作为可供选择的数据池。具体而言，我们的框架提出，在每个训练步骤中，使用通用训练数据构建一个模型更新方向的可行集，并将稀缺目标数据所指定的模型更新方向投影到该可行集上。标准训练和现有的数据选择方法可以看作是在不同数据诱导正则化器选择下的特例，而这些方法对应于不同的
tldr: 该论文提出 Dr. Post-Training 框架，创新性地将通用训练数据重新概念化为防止模型过拟合稀缺目标数据的数据诱导正则化器，通过在每步训练中将目标数据的更新方向投影到通用数据构建的可行集上，并将标准训练与现有数据选择方法统一为该框架下的特例。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Dr. Post-Training, a novel framework that reconceptualizes general training data as a data-induced regularizer against overfitting to scarce target data, by projecting target-specified update directions onto a feasible set constructed from general data at each training step, unifying standard training and existing data selection methods as special cases.
